chapterInfo.content:
4
Ohiani, nsiyɛfoɔ ne ɔhene
1Na mesane mehwɛɛ nhyɛsoɔ a wɔyɛ no owia yi aseɛ no nyinaa, na hwɛ, wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn soɔ no nisuo, na wɔnni ɔwerɛkyekyefoɔ biara, na nhyɛsofoɔ nsam den no mu no, wɔnni ɔwerɛkyekyefoɔ bi! 2#Hiob 3.11 Ɛnna medwenee sɛ awufoɔ a wɔawuwu dada no tiri ayɛ yie sene nnipa a wɔda so tete aseɛ no. 3#Ɔsɛ 6.3 Na deɛ ɔyɛ sene wɔn baanu no ne deɛ ɔnnya mmaeɛ a ɔnnya nhunuu nneyɛɛ bɔne a wɔyɛ no owia yi aseɛ no.
4Na mehunuu ɔbrɛ nyinaa ne adwumayɛ mu yiedie nyinaa nso, sɛ ɛno ho na obi ne ne yɔnko twe ninkunu: Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ ne dadwene hunu.
5 # Mmb 6.10 Ɔkwasea pompono ne nsa tena hɔ, na ɔdi ɔno ara ne honam.
6 # Mmb 15.16 Kommyɛ kakra yɛ sene ɔbrɛ ne dadwene hunu bebree.
7 # Ɔsɛ 2.12 Na mesane mehwɛɛ owia yi ase ahuhudeɛ. 8Ɔbaako wɔ hɔ na obiara nka ne ho, nso ɔnni babarima anaa onuabarima, nanso ne brɛ nyinaa nni awieeɛ, ahonya nso mmee n’ani. Na hwan mpo na merebrɛ na merekame me kra nnepa mama no? Yei nso, ahuhudeɛ ne ɔhaw bɔne ne no.
9Baanu yɛ sene baako, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn brɛ mu akatua pa wɔ hɔ ma wɔn; 10na sɛ wɔhwe ase a, ɔbaako bɛma ne yɔnko so, na ɔbaakofoɔ a ɔhwe aseɛ a obi nka ne ho mma no soɔ nnue. 11Bio, sɛ baanu da a, wɔn ho yɛ wɔn hye, na ɔbaakofoɔ deɛ, ne ho bɛyɛ no hye sɛn? 12Na sɛ obi toa ɔbaakofoɔ a, ɔrentumi nnyina, nanso baanu ne no bɛdi asie; na ahoma a wɔaka abɔ ho mmiɛnsa no rente ntɛm.
13Fanyinam aberantewaa hiani nyansafoɔ sene ɔhene akɔkoraa kwasea a ɔntie afotuo bio. 14#Gye 41.14 Na obi firi nneduafoɔ dan mu bɛdii hene, nso wɔwoo no hiani n’ahennie asase no so. 15Mehunuu ateasefoɔ a wɔnam owia yi aseɛ nyinaa ne aberantewaa foforɔ a ɔbɛgyinaa n’ananmu no. 16#Ɔsɛ 1.14 Ɔman no nyinaa, wɔn a wɔdii n’anim nyinaa nni awieeɛ, nso wɔn a wɔbɛba akyire yi no ani rennye ne ho. Ampa ara, yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ ne dadwene hunu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na mesane mehwɛɛ nhyɛsoɔ a wɔyɛ no owia yi aseɛ no nyinaa, na hwɛ, wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn soɔ no nisuo, na wɔnni ɔwerɛkyekyefoɔ biara, na nhyɛsofoɔ nsam den no mu no, wɔnni ɔwerɛkyekyefoɔ bi! Ɛnna medwenee sɛ awufoɔ a wɔawuwu dada no tiri ayɛ yie sene nnipa a wɔda so tete aseɛ no. Na deɛ ɔyɛ sene wɔn baanu no ne deɛ ɔnnya mmaeɛ a ɔnnya nhunuu nneyɛɛ bɔne a wɔyɛ no owia yi aseɛ no.
Na mehunuu ɔbrɛ nyinaa ne adwumayɛ mu yiedie nyinaa nso, sɛ ɛno ho na obi ne ne yɔnko twe ninkunu: Yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ ne dadwene hunu.
Ɔkwasea pompono ne nsa tena hɔ, na ɔdi ɔno ara ne honam.
Kommyɛ kakra yɛ sene ɔbrɛ ne dadwene hunu bebree.
Na mesane mehwɛɛ owia yi ase ahuhudeɛ. Ɔbaako wɔ hɔ na obiara nka ne ho, nso ɔnni babarima anaa onuabarima, nanso ne brɛ nyinaa nni awieeɛ, ahonya nso mmee n’ani. Na hwan mpo na merebrɛ na merekame me kra nnepa mama no? Yei nso, ahuhudeɛ ne ɔhaw bɔne ne no.
Baanu yɛ sene baako, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn brɛ mu akatua pa wɔ hɔ ma wɔn; na sɛ wɔhwe ase a, ɔbaako bɛma ne yɔnko so, na ɔbaakofoɔ a ɔhwe aseɛ a obi nka ne ho mma no soɔ nnue. Bio, sɛ baanu da a, wɔn ho yɛ wɔn hye, na ɔbaakofoɔ deɛ, ne ho bɛyɛ no hye sɛn? Na sɛ obi toa ɔbaakofoɔ a, ɔrentumi nnyina, nanso baanu ne no bɛdi asie; na ahoma a wɔaka abɔ ho mmiɛnsa no rente ntɛm.
Fanyinam aberantewaa hiani nyansafoɔ sene ɔhene akɔkoraa kwasea a ɔntie afotuo bio. Na obi firi nneduafoɔ dan mu bɛdii hene, nso wɔwoo no hiani n’ahennie asase no so. Mehunuu ateasefoɔ a wɔnam owia yi aseɛ nyinaa ne aberantewaa foforɔ a ɔbɛgyinaa n’ananmu no. Ɔman no nyinaa, wɔn a wɔdii n’anim nyinaa nni awieeɛ, nso wɔn a wɔbɛba akyire yi no ani rennye ne ho. Ampa ara, yei nso yɛ ahuhudeɛ ne dadwene hunu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
